products.name: Architecture Service — Microsoft Defender for Cloud — Commercial
products.short_description: Design Defender for Cloud right the first time — a reference architecture and design service for multicloud posture and workload protection at scale.
products.description:
Design Defender for Cloud right the first time — a reference architecture and design service for multicloud posture and workload protection at scale.

Rolling Defender for Cloud across many subscriptions and clouds without a design produces inconsistent coverage, RBAC sprawl, and cost surprises. This architecture service delivers a reference design: management-group/subscription onboarding model, plan-enablement strategy, multicloud (AWS/GCP) connectors, RBAC and governance, continuous export/SIEM integration, and cost model.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Reference architecture for Defender for Cloud at scale (MG/subscription model)
  • Plan-enablement strategy (CSPM + workload plans) and rollout waves
  • Multicloud connectors (AWS/GCP) and hybrid coverage design
  • RBAC, governance rules, exemptions, and continuous-export/SIEM design
  • Cost model and a decision/design record

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A scalable, documented Defender for Cloud architecture — consistent coverage, clean RBAC, multicloud, and a cost model, before you roll out.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ARCMDC-Deploy.ps1 — deploy the reference main.bicep at management-group scope
    • ARCMDC-Discovery.ps1 — read-only discovery for the Defender for Cloud reference architecture:
    • ARCMDC-Report.ps1 — coverage report (with drift vs a saved baseline) and an indicative cost
    • ARCMDC-Validate.ps1 — confirm the architecture: plans enabled at scope, inheritance working,

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
